mentions.name: Hermit
mentions.description: A JavaScript runner for executing untrusted code whose entire API is exposed only via messages passed over stdio. It layers multiple security mechanisms, including V8 isolates, two-stage seccomp, frozen globals, mount namespaces, and Landlock.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I've been working on JavaScript runner for untrusted code. The whole API is only exposed via messages passed over stdio. Security layers: V8 isolates, two-stage seccomp, frozen globals, mount namespaces, landlock, and more.
https://github.com/jonathannen/hermit
